candidate.absence_scope: The full pinned servers/rendering/rendering_server.cpp default-registration source contains no shader_cache/enabled.web registration. Existing repository project.godot was read only and had no explicit shader_cache setting at initial diagnosis.
source_proven_effects: Non-editor GLES3 initialization reads enabled and leaves shader_cache_dir empty when false; ShaderGLES3 then skips per-shader name/hash mkdir.
RasterizerGLES3 still creates the top-level user://shader_cache before the enabled check.
WEB_ENABLED already returns false from GPU-binary cache load and returns immediately from GPU-binary cache save.
Shader variant compilation follows the unchanged _compile_specialization path when binary cache load returns false. This candidate does not disable shader compilation or browser-managed WebGL caches.
caveats: Existing persistent shader-cache directories are not deleted or migrated by this setting.
Actual 33 IndexedDB keys must be audited before identifying them as shader-cache directories.
Fresh-profile directory reduction and the unchanged 30-second primary commit/restart requirements need actual verification.
Engine serial cursor callbacks are asynchronous tasks; no one-cursor-per-frame scheduling guarantee is claimed.
No browser, Godot, or Blender was launched and no repository source file was changed for this provenance task.

claims.claim: Shader cache is registered enabled=true with no web=false default registration in this source.
The default cache base is user://; top-level shader_cache is created, then enabled controls per-shader name/hash directories.
WebGL cannot use this Godot GPU program-binary load/save cache. Actual shader compilation is preserved.
Dirty state starts async FS.syncfs on a subsequent main loop iteration; force_fs_sync only requests dirty state.
Remote timestamps are collected through openKeyCursor and cursor.continue before reconcile starts its readwrite transaction, whose oncomplete invokes the callback.
The serial cursor plus long runtime frame tasks is consistent with the observed delay but does not identify the actual 33 keys or prove the root cause/performance improvement.
